fields.summary: Autonomous plan run with no owner present, so no owner words were captured. The question raised by the plan run, how many times a failed review fixer may be retried inside its cycle, was answered by the arbiter: a failed review fixer is retried within its cycle up to MaxFixCycles more times, and only when those retries are exhausted is the cycle spent. The checks of a spent cycle then fail with the fix-failed detail. Open: none for this change set.
fields.title: Failed fixer keeps its cycle: arbiter ruling
